Name.Translated: DLSS 超分辨率 - 启用 DLL 覆盖

Description.Original: If enabled, overrides DLSS-SR with the latest global version installed (${DlssVersion}).\r\nNVIDIA periodically push OTA updates for the override, though it often lags behind the actual latest available online.\r\nOnly DLSS2+ games support the override, certain games may also disallow using it.
Description.Translated: 启用后，将 DLSS-SR 覆盖为当前已安装的最新全局版本 (${DlssVersion})。\r\nNVIDIA 会定期通过 OTA 推送覆盖版本更新，但通常落后于网上实际可用的最新版本。\r\n仅 DLSS2+ 游戏支持覆盖，某些游戏也可能禁止使用此功能。

Value.original: On - DLSS-SR overridden by latest installed (${DlssVersion})
Value.translated: 开启 - 将 DLSS-SR 覆盖为已安装的最新版本 (${DlssVersion})

Name.Translated: DLSS 超分辨率 - 强制模型预设配置

Description.Original: If "Forced Preset Letter" has no effect, this setting may need to be changed for the game to apply the custom preset.
Description.Translated: 如果“强制预设字母”没有效果，可能需要更改此设置，游戏才会应用自定义预设。

Name.Translated: DLSS 光线重建 - 启用 DLL 覆盖

Description.Original: If enabled, overrides DLSS-RR with the latest global version installed (${DlssdVersion}).\r\nNVIDIA periodically push OTA updates for the override, though it often lags behind the actual latest available online.\r\nOnly DLSS2+ games support the override, certain games may also disallow using it.
Description.Translated: 启用后，将 DLSS-RR 覆盖为当前已安装的最新全局版本 (${DlssdVersion})。\r\nNVIDIA 会定期通过 OTA 推送覆盖版本更新，但通常落后于网上实际可用的最新版本。\r\n仅 DLSS2+ 游戏支持覆盖，某些游戏也可能禁止使用此功能。

Value.original: On - DLSS-RR overridden by latest installed (${DlssdVersion})
Value.translated: 开启 - 将 DLSS-RR 覆盖为已安装的最新版本 (${DlssdVersion})

Name.Translated: DLSS 帧生成 - 启用 DLL 覆盖

Description.Original: If enabled, overrides DLSS-FG with the latest global version installed (${DlssgVersion}).\r\nNVIDIA periodically push OTA updates for the override, though it often lags behind the actual latest available online.\r\nOnly DLSS2+ games support the override, certain games may also disallow using it.
Description.Translated: 启用后，将 DLSS-FG 覆盖为当前已安装的最新全局版本 (${DlssgVersion})。\r\nNVIDIA 会定期通过 OTA 推送覆盖版本更新，但通常落后于网上实际可用的最新版本。\r\n仅 DLSS2+ 游戏支持覆盖，某些游戏也可能禁止使用此功能。

Value.original: On - DLSS-FG overridden by latest installed (${DlssgVersion})
Value.translated: 开启 - 将 DLSS-FG 覆盖为已安装的最新版本 (${DlssgVersion})

Name.Translated: DLSS 超分辨率 - 强制预设字母

Description.Original: NOTE: "DLSS - Forced Model Preset Profile" setting may need to be changed for this to apply on certain games.\r\nIf set, overrides the DLSS preset/model used across all quality levels (may not be desirable on some levels).
Description.Translated: 注意：在某些游戏中，可能需要更改“DLSS 超分辨率 - 强制模型预设配置”才能使此设置生效。\r\n设置后，将覆盖所有画质级别使用的 DLSS 预设/模型（某些级别可能不适合这样设置）。

Value.translated: 预设 J (Transformer 第 1 代)
预设 K (Transformer 第 1 代)
预设 L (Transformer 第 2 代)
预设 M (Transformer 第 2 代)

Name.Translated: DLSS 光线重建 - 强制预设字母

Description.Original: Forces a specific DLSS Ray Reconstruction model preset when the application honors preset overrides.
Description.Translated: 在应用程序允许覆盖预设时，强制使用指定的 DLSS 光线重建模型预设。

Value.translated: 预设 D (Transformer 第 1 代)
预设 E (Transformer 第 1 代)
预设 F (Transformer 第 2 代)

Name.Translated: DLSS-NR 神经渲染 - 启用 DLL 覆盖

Description.Original: If enabled, overrides DLSS-NR with the latest global version installed (${DlssnrVersion}).\r\nNVIDIA periodically push OTA updates for the override, though it often lags behind the actual latest available online.\r\nOnly DLSS2+ games support the override, certain games may also disallow using it.
Description.Translated: 启用后，将 DLSS-NR 覆盖为当前已安装的最新全局版本 (${DlssnrVersion})。\r\nNVIDIA 会定期通过 OTA 推送覆盖版本更新，但通常落后于网上实际可用的最新版本。\r\n仅 DLSS2+ 游戏支持覆盖，某些游戏也可能禁止使用此功能。

Value.original: On - DLSS-NR overridden by latest installed (${DlssnrVersion})
Value.translated: 开启 - 将 DLSS-NR 覆盖为已安装的最新版本 (${DlssnrVersion})

Name.Translated: DLSS-NR 神经渲染 - 启用 Streamline 覆盖

Description.Original: If enabled, overrides Streamline DLSS-NR with the latest global version installed.\r\nNVIDIA periodically push OTA updates for the override, though it often lags behind the actual latest available online.\r\nOnly DLSS2+ games support the override, certain games may also disallow using it.
Description.Translated: 启用后，将 Streamline DLSS-NR 覆盖为当前已安装的最新全局版本。\r\nNVIDIA 会定期通过 OTA 推送覆盖版本更新，但通常落后于网上实际可用的最新版本。\r\n仅 DLSS2+ 游戏支持覆盖，某些游戏也可能禁止使用此功能。

Value.original: On - Streamline DLSS-NR overridden by latest installed
Value.translated: 开启 - 将 Streamline DLSS-NR 覆盖为已安装的最新版本

Name.Translated: DLSS-NR 神经渲染 - 强制预设字母

Description.Original: Forces a specific DLSS Neural Rendering model preset when the application honors preset overrides.
Description.Translated: 在应用程序允许覆盖预设时，强制使用指定的 DLSS 神经渲染模型预设。

Name.Translated: DLSS 超分辨率 - 启用 Streamline 覆盖
DLSS 帧生成 - 场景自动切换检测

Description.Original: Auto Scene Change Detection aims to automatically prevent Frame Generation from producing difficult-to-create frames between a substantial scene change. It does this by analyzing the in-game camera orientation on every input DLSS Frame Generation frame pair.
Description.Translated: 场景自动切换检测旨在避免帧生成在场景发生较大变化时生成难以处理的过渡帧。它会分析每一对 DLSS 帧生成输入帧中的游戏相机朝向。

Name.Translated: DLSS 帧生成 - 全屏菜单检测

Description.Original: Controls the full-screen menu detection mode used by DLSS Frame Generation heuristics.
Description.Translated: 控制 DLSS 帧生成启发式处理所使用的全屏菜单检测模式。

Name.Original: DLSS-FG - Full-Screen Menu Override Coverage Threshold (float)
Name.Translated: DLSS 帧生成 - 全屏菜单覆盖率阈值 (float)

Description.Original: Sets the screen-coverage threshold used by the DLSS Frame Generation full-screen menu override heuristic.
Description.Translated: 设置 DLSS 帧生成全屏菜单覆盖启发式处理所使用的屏幕覆盖率阈值。

Name.Original: DLSS-FG - Full-Screen Menu Override Alpha Threshold (float)
Name.Translated: DLSS 帧生成 - 全屏菜单 Alpha 阈值 (float)

Description.Original: Sets the alpha threshold used by the DLSS Frame Generation full-screen menu override heuristic.
Description.Translated: 设置 DLSS 帧生成全屏菜单覆盖启发式处理所使用的 Alpha 阈值。

Name.Translated: DLSS 超分辨率 - 强制画质级别

Description.Original: Forces a predefined DLSS Super Resolution quality level for the profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置强制使用预定义的 DLSS 超分辨率画质级别。

Name.Translated: DLSS 光线重建 - 强制画质级别

Description.Original: Forces a predefined DLSS Ray Reconstruction quality level for the profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置强制使用预定义的 DLSS 光线重建画质级别。

Name.Translated: DLSS 超分辨率 - 强制缩放比例

Description.Original: Set up 'DLSS - Forced Quality Level: Custom' before choosing the custom value.
Description.Translated: 选择自定义值之前，请先将“DLSS 超分辨率 - 强制画质级别”设为“自定义”。

Name.Translated: DLSS 光线重建 - 强制缩放比例

Description.Original: Set up 'DLSS-RR - Forced Quality Level: Custom' before choosing the custom value.
Description.Translated: 选择自定义值之前，请先将“DLSS 光线重建 - 强制画质级别”设为“自定义”。

Name.Translated: DLSS 多帧生成 - 固定帧生成数量

Description.Original: Selects the multi-frame generation cadence used by supported DLSS Frame Generation implementations.
Description.Translated: 选择受支持的 DLSS 帧生成实现所使用的多帧生成节奏。

Name.Translated: 平滑动态 - 启用

Description.Original: Enables or disables Smooth Motion for the profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置启用或禁用平滑动态。

Name.Translated: 平滑动态 - 允许的 API

Description.Original: If the setting doesn't exist in profile (greyed out) all APIs will be allowed, if setting exists and is set to 0, no APIs are allowed
Description.Translated: 如果配置中不存在此设置（显示为灰色），则允许所有 API；如果此设置存在且设为 0，则不允许任何 API。

Name.Translated: 平滑动态 - 调试日志级别

Description.Original: Logs written to C:\NvPresent\
Description.Translated: 日志写入 C:\NvPresent\

Name.Translated: 平滑动态 - 调试条

Description.Original: Draws colored bars on generated frames.
Description.Translated: 在生成的帧上绘制彩色条。

Name.Translated: 平滑动态 - Flip Metering 0

Description.Original: Shows "HW Flip Metering Supported via public queue" in log file when set.
Description.Translated: 设置后，日志文件中会显示“HW Flip Metering Supported via public queue”。

Name.Translated: 平滑动态 - Flip Metering 1

Description.Original: May change HW flip metering to "App queue" if set.
Description.Translated: 设置后，可能会将硬件 Flip Metering 更改为“App queue”。

Name.Translated: RTX HDR - 驱动标志

Description.Original: Allows reducing deband strength to preserve details & enable indicator. When any driver flags are set HDR will be applied via driver instead of through NVOverlay (driver doesn't support customizing brightness/contrast/saturation)
Description.Translated: 允许降低去色带强度以保留细节，并启用指示器。 设置任意驱动标志后，HDR 将通过驱动而非 NVOverlay 应用（驱动方式不支持自定义亮度、对比度和饱和度）。

Value.translated: 通过驱动启用（无去色带）(0x06)
通过驱动启用（中等去色带）(0x0A)
通过驱动启用（极高去色带）(0x02)
启用 + 指示器 + 调试（极高）(0x23)

Name.Translated: RTX HDR - 启用

Description.Original: Enables or disables RTX HDR processing for the profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置启用或禁用 RTX HDR 处理。

Name.Translated: RTX HDR - 峰值亮度

Description.Original: Sets the target peak brightness used by RTX HDR tone mapping.
Description.Translated: 设置 RTX HDR 色调映射使用的目标峰值亮度。

Name.Translated: RTX HDR - 中间灰

Description.Original: Sets the RTX HDR middle-grey reference used for tone mapping.
Description.Translated: 设置 RTX HDR 色调映射使用的中间灰参考值。

Name.Translated: RTX HDR - 对比度

Description.Original: Sets the RTX HDR contrast adjustment applied by the profile.
Description.Translated: 设置此配置应用的 RTX HDR 对比度调整值。

Name.Translated: RTX HDR - 饱和度

Description.Original: Sets the RTX HDR saturation adjustment applied after tone mapping.
Description.Translated: 设置 RTX HDR 在色调映射之后应用的饱和度调整值。

Name.Translated: RTX 动态亮丽 - 启用

Description.Original: Enables or disables the RTX Dynamic Vibrance post-processing path.
Description.Translated: 启用或禁用 RTX 动态亮丽 (RTX Dynamic Vibrance) 后处理路径。

Name.Translated: RTX 动态亮丽 - 饱和度增强

Description.Original: Sets the additional saturation boost applied by RTX Dynamic Vibrance.
Description.Translated: 设置 RTX 动态亮丽应用的额外饱和度增强值。

Name.Translated: RTX 动态亮丽 - 强度

Description.Original: Sets the RTX Dynamic Vibrance intensity value applied by the profile.
Description.Translated: 设置此配置应用的 RTX 动态亮丽强度值。

Name.Original: DLSS - Override Performance to be Ultra Performance
Name.Translated: DLSS 超分辨率 - 将性能模式覆盖为超级性能

Description.Original: Remaps the Performance quality selection to use the Ultra Performance path.
Description.Translated: 将“性能”画质选项映射为使用“超级性能”处理路径。

Name.Original: DLSS - Override DLSS modes to be DLAA
Name.Translated: DLSS 超分辨率 - 将 DLSS 模式覆盖为 DLAA

Description.Original: Redirects DLSS Super Resolution quality modes to operate as DLAA-style full-resolution rendering.
Description.Translated: 将 DLSS 超分辨率画质模式重定向为类似 DLAA 的全分辨率渲染。

Name.Translated: 帧率限制 - 后台应用程序

Description.Original: Sets the frame-rate cap applied when the profiled application is running in the background.
Description.Translated: 设置应用程序在后台运行时的帧率上限。

Name.Translated: 着色器缓存 - 大小

Description.Original: Selects the maximum shader cache size allowed for this profile.
Description.Translated: 选择此配置允许使用的最大着色器缓存大小。

Name.Translated: 着色器缓存 - 启用 (OpenGL)

Description.Original: Enables or disables the OpenGL shader cache for this profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置启用或禁用 OpenGL 着色器缓存。

Name.Translated: rBAR - 启用

Description.Original: Enables or disables profile-controlled Resizable BAR behavior.
Description.Translated: 启用或禁用由配置控制的 Resizable BAR 行为。

Name.Translated: rBAR - 启用 v2

Description.Original: Disabled turns off all reBAR settings, Enabled uses all the reBAR settings, Auto uses driver recommended settings.
Description.Translated: “禁用”会关闭所有 reBAR 设置；“启用”会使用所有 reBAR 设置；“自动”会使用驱动推荐的设置。

Name.Translated: rBAR - 选项

Description.Original: Defines the primary Resizable BAR option bitfield used by the driver.
Description.Translated: 定义驱动使用的主要 Resizable BAR 选项位域。

Name.Translated: rBAR - Intel CPU 排除

Description.Original: Stores the Intel CPU exclusion mask used by the Resizable BAR policy logic.
Description.Translated: 保存 Resizable BAR 策略逻辑使用的 Intel CPU 排除掩码。

Name.Translated: rBAR - 大小限制

Description.Original: Default Size Limit value for most of the whitelisted games is '1GB', some games MAY benefit of a higher size bar.
Description.Translated: 大多数白名单游戏的默认大小限制为“1GB”；部分游戏可能受益于更大的 BAR 空间。

Name.Translated: rBAR - 标志 (0x000F00BE)

Description.Original: Stores auxiliary Resizable BAR driver flags for advanced compatibility handling.
Description.Translated: 保存用于高级兼容性处理的辅助 Resizable BAR 驱动标志。

Name.Translated: rBAR - 标志 (0x000F00BF)

Description.Original: Stores secondary Resizable BAR driver flags for advanced compatibility handling.
Description.Translated: 保存用于高级兼容性处理的另一组 Resizable BAR 驱动标志。

Name.Translated: G-SYNC - 支持状态指示浮层

Description.Original: Controls the on-screen overlay that reports whether the current presentation path supports G-SYNC.
Description.Translated: 控制用于显示当前呈现路径是否支持 G-SYNC 的屏幕浮层。

Name.Translated: 光线追踪 - 启用 (DXR)

Description.Original: Enables or disables DirectX Raytracing support for this profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置启用或禁用 DirectX 光线追踪支持。

Name.Translated: 光线追踪 - 启用 (Vulkan RT)

Description.Original: Enables or disables Vulkan ray tracing support for this profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置启用或禁用 Vulkan 光线追踪支持。

Name.Translated: NVIDIA Ansel - 启用

Description.Original: Enables or disables NVIDIA Ansel support for the profile. Ansel is a photo mode for supported games developed by NVIDIA, allowing the use of a free camera to take photos of a game. The mode is also able to increase the graphical fidelity of a game so players do not have to change settings manually as they engage or disengage the photo mode.
Description.Translated: 为此配置启用或禁用 NVIDIA Ansel 支持。Ansel 是 NVIDIA 为受支持游戏开发的拍照模式，允许使用自由相机拍摄游戏画面。此模式还可提高游戏的画面精细度，使玩家在进入或退出拍照模式时无需手动更改设置。

Name.Translated: NVIDIA App 浮层 - 标志

Description.Original: Controls NVIDIA App Overlay (formerly ShadowPlay) capture flags.
Description.Translated: 控制 NVIDIA App 浮层（原 ShadowPlay）的捕获标志。

Value.translated: 将应用程序加入桌面捕获白名单
禁用 NVIDIA App 统计信息

Name.Translated: 锐化滤镜 - 启用

Description.Original: Enables or disables the driver image sharpening filter.
Description.Translated: 启用或禁用驱动图像锐化滤镜。

Name.Translated: 锐化 - 强度

Description.Original: Sets the sharpening intensity applied by the driver image sharpening filter.
Description.Translated: 设置驱动图像锐化滤镜应用的锐化强度。

Name.Translated: 锐化 - 忽略胶片颗粒

Description.Original: Controls how strongly detected film grain is excluded from the driver sharpening pass.
Description.Translated: 控制驱动锐化处理在多大程度上排除检测到的胶片颗粒。

Name.Translated: 帧率限制器 V3

Description.Original: Sets the foreground frame-rate cap applied by the third-generation driver frame limiter.
Description.Translated: 设置第三代驱动帧率限制器应用于前台程序的帧率上限。

Name.Translated: 超低延迟 - 控制面板状态

Description.Original: This setting just keeps track of ULL setting for the nvidia control panel. No need to change it.
Description.Translated: 此设置仅用于记录 NVIDIA 控制面板中的超低延迟 (ULL) 设置，无需更改。

Name.Translated: 超低延迟 - 启用

Description.Original: Enables or disables the driver Ultra Low Latency scheduling path for this profile. Also recommended to set up "Maximum Pre-rendered Frames" flag to 1.
Description.Translated: 为此配置启用或禁用驱动的超低延迟调度路径。同时建议将“最大预渲染帧数”设为 1。

Name.Translated: 纹理过滤 - 质量替代

Description.Original: Controls whether the selected texture filtering quality preset is replaced by a profile override.
Description.Translated: 控制是否用配置覆盖值替代所选的纹理过滤质量预设。

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 - 启用 MFAA

Description.Original: Enables or disables multi-frame sampled antialiasing for this profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置启用或禁用多帧采样抗锯齿。

Name.Translated: 首选刷新率

Description.Original: Selects the preferred display refresh-rate policy used for this profile.
Description.Translated: 选择此配置使用的首选显示刷新率策略。

Value.translated: 使用 3D 应用程序设置

Name.Translated: G-SYNC - 运行状态指示浮层

Description.Original: Controls the on-screen overlay that reports active G-SYNC status.
Description.Translated: 控制用于显示 G-SYNC 当前运行状态的屏幕浮层。

Name.Translated: G-SYNC - 应用程序模式

Description.Original: Selects the G-SYNC operating mode advertised to the application.
Description.Translated: 选择向应用程序报告的 G-SYNC 运行模式。

Name.Translated: G-SYNC - 全局模式

Description.Original: Selects the global G-SYNC operating mode for this profile.
Description.Translated: 选择此配置的全局 G-SYNC 运行模式。

Name.Translated: G-SYNC - 全局功能

Description.Original: Globally enables or disables G-SYNC support for this profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置全局启用或禁用 G-SYNC 支持。

Name.Translated: G-SYNC - 应用程序状态

Description.Original: Controls the effective G-SYNC state applied when the profile is active.
Description.Translated: 控制此配置生效时应用的 G-SYNC 有效状态。

Name.Translated: G-SYNC - 应用程序请求状态

Description.Original: Controls the application-requested G-SYNC state.
Description.Translated: 控制应用程序请求的 G-SYNC 状态。

Name.Translated: 禁止各向异性过滤

Description.Original: Prevents the application or driver from enabling anisotropic filtering for this profile.
Description.Translated: 阻止应用程序或驱动为此配置启用各向异性过滤。

Name.Translated: 着色器缓存 - 启用

Description.Original: Enables or disables the Direct3D shader cache for this profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置启用或禁用 Direct3D 着色器缓存。

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿修正 (DX9)

Description.Original: Enables or disables the Direct3D 9 antialiasing fix path for applications that require profile-based AA handling.
Description.Translated: 为需要通过配置处理抗锯齿的应用程序启用或禁用 Direct3D 9 抗锯齿修正路径。

Name.Translated: 垂直同步 - 平滑 AFR 行为

Description.Original: Controls how vertical synchronization behaves when smooth AFR multi-GPU pacing is active.
Description.Translated: 控制启用平滑 AFR 多 GPU 帧节奏时的垂直同步行为。

Name.Original: Texture Filtering - LOD Bias Auto-Adjust (for SGSSAA)
Name.Translated: 纹理过滤 - 自动调整 LOD 偏移 (SGSSAA)

Description.Original: Enables automatic negative LOD bias adjustment when sparse grid supersampling is active.
Description.Translated: 在启用稀疏网格超级采样时，自动调整负 LOD 偏移。

Name.Translated: 翻转指示器

Description.Original: Selects the debug overlay mode used to display flip-model and presentation status information.
Description.Translated: 选择用于显示翻转模型和呈现状态信息的调试浮层模式。

Value.original: GRAPH_FLIP_FPS - FPS graph, measured on display hw flip
Value.translated: GRAPH_FLIP_FPS - FPS 图表，在显示硬件翻转时测量

Value.original: GRAPH_PRESENT_FPS - FPS graph, measured when the user mode driver starts processing present
Value.translated: GRAPH_PRESENT_FPS - FPS 图表，在用户态驱动开始处理呈现时测量

Value.original: GRAPH_APP_PRESENT_FPS - FPS graph, measured on app present
Value.translated: GRAPH_APP_PRESENT_FPS - FPS 图表，在应用程序提交呈现时测量

Value.original: DISPLAY_PAGING - Add red paging indicator bars to the GRAPH_PRESENT_FPS graph
Value.translated: DISPLAY_PAGING - 在 GRAPH_PRESENT_FPS 图表中添加红色分页指示条

Value.original: DISPLAY_APP_THREAD_WAIT - Add app thread wait time indiator bars to the GRAPH_APP_PRESENT_FPS graph
Value.translated: DISPLAY_APP_THREAD_WAIT - 在 GRAPH_APP_PRESENT_FPS 图表中添加应用程序线程等待时间指示条
启用 - 启用全部功能

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 - 启用 FXAA

Description.Original: Enables or disables driver-forced FXAA for this profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置启用或禁用驱动强制的 FXAA。

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 - FXAA 指示浮层

Description.Original: Controls the on-screen overlay that indicates when FXAA is active.
Description.Translated: 控制用于指示 FXAA 已生效的屏幕浮层。

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 - 启用 FXAA（NVIDIA 预定义）

Description.Original: Controls the predefined FXAA state applied by the driver profile.
Description.Translated: 控制驱动配置应用的预定义 FXAA 状态。

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 - 线条伽马

Description.Original: Selects the line gamma adjustment mode used during antialiasing.
Description.Translated: 选择抗锯齿处理期间使用的线条伽马调整模式。

Name.Translated: 纹理过滤 - LOD 偏移 (DX)

Description.Original: Sets the Direct3D texture LOD bias override for this profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置设置 Direct3D 纹理 LOD 偏移覆盖值。

Name.Translated: 纹理过滤 - LOD 偏移 (OGL)

Description.Original: Sets the OpenGL texture LOD bias override for this profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置设置 OpenGL 纹理 LOD 偏移覆盖值。

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 - 兼容性 (DX9)

Description.Original: Defines the Direct3D 9 antialiasing compatibility bitfield used for application-specific AA behavior.
Description.Translated: 定义用于应用程序特定抗锯齿行为的 Direct3D 9 抗锯齿兼容性位域。

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 - 兼容性 (DX1x)

Description.Original: Defines the Direct3D 10 and Direct3D 11 antialiasing compatibility bitfield used for application-specific AA behavior.
Description.Translated: 定义用于应用程序特定抗锯齿行为的 Direct3D 10 和 Direct3D 11 抗锯齿兼容性位域。

Name.Translated: 环境光遮蔽 - 兼容性

Description.Original: Defines the ambient occlusion compatibility bitfield used for application-specific driver workarounds.
Description.Translated: 定义用于应用程序特定驱动兼容性处理的环境光遮蔽兼容性位域。

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 - 伽马校正

Description.Original: Enables or disables gamma-correct antialiasing resolve behavior.
Description.Translated: 启用或禁用带伽马校正的抗锯齿解析行为。

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 (MSAA) - 行为标志

Description.Original: Controls advanced MSAA behavior flags and application-compatibility overrides.
Description.Translated: 控制高级 MSAA 行为标志及应用程序兼容性覆盖设置。

Value.translated: 将“覆盖任何应用程序设置”视为“由应用程序控制”

Value.original: Treat 'Override any application setting' as 'Enhance the application setting'
Value.translated: 将“覆盖任何应用程序设置”视为“增强应用程序设置”
禁用“覆盖任何应用程序设置”
将“增强应用程序设置”视为“由应用程序控制”

Value.original: Treat 'Enhance the application setting' as 'Override any application setting'
Value.translated: 将“增强应用程序设置”视为“覆盖任何应用程序设置”
禁用“增强应用程序设置”

Value.original: Disable Antialiasing at NVIDIA Control Panel
Value.translated: 禁用 NVIDIA 控制面板中的抗锯齿

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 (MSAA) - 模式

Description.Original: Selects whether MSAA is application-controlled, enhanced, or fully overridden by the driver.
Description.Translated: 选择 MSAA 由应用程序控制、由驱动增强，还是由驱动完全覆盖。

Value.translated: 覆盖任何应用程序设置

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 (MSAA) - 设置

Description.Original: Selects the MSAA sample pattern and quality level applied by the driver.
Description.Translated: 选择驱动应用的 MSAA 采样模式和质量级别。

Value.translated: 由应用程序控制 / 关闭
8x [8x CSAA（4 个颜色样本 + 4 个 cv 样本）]
16x [16x CSAA（4 个颜色样本 + 12 个 cv 样本）]
16xQ [16x CSAA（8 个颜色样本 + 8 个 cv 样本）]
32x [32x CSAA（8 个颜色样本 + 24 个 cv 样本）]

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 - 透明度多重采样

Description.Original: Controls whether transparency multisampling is used for alpha-tested geometry.
Description.Translated: 控制是否对使用 Alpha 测试的几何体使用透明度多重采样。

Name.Translated: 抗锯齿 - 透明度超级采样

Description.Original: Selects the transparency supersampling mode for alpha-tested geometry.
Description.Translated: 选择对使用 Alpha 测试的几何体应用的透明度超级采样模式。

Name.Translated: 各向异性过滤 - 模式

Description.Original: Selects whether anisotropic filtering is application-controlled or forced by the driver.
Description.Translated: 选择各向异性过滤由应用程序控制，还是由驱动强制应用。

Name.Translated: 各向异性过滤 - 级别

Description.Original: Selects the anisotropic filtering level applied when the driver forces AF.
Description.Translated: 选择驱动强制应用各向异性过滤 (AF) 时使用的级别。

Name.Translated: 各向异性过滤 - 优化

Description.Original: Enables or disables the driver anisotropic filtering optimization path.
Description.Translated: 启用或禁用驱动各向异性过滤优化路径。

Name.Translated: 各向异性过滤 - 采样优化

Description.Original: Enables or disables sample-count optimizations for anisotropic filtering.
Description.Translated: 启用或禁用各向异性过滤的采样数量优化。

Name.Translated: 纹理过滤 - 负 LOD 偏移

Description.Original: Controls whether negative texture LOD bias is clamped or allowed.
Description.Translated: 控制允许还是钳制负纹理 LOD 偏移。

Name.Translated: 纹理过滤 - 质量

Description.Original: Selects the global texture filtering quality preset.
Description.Translated: 选择全局纹理过滤质量预设。

Name.Translated: 纹理过滤 - 三线性优化

Description.Original: Enables or disables the trilinear filtering optimization path.
Description.Translated: 启用或禁用三线性过滤优化路径。

Value.original: On ( will be ignored if using high quality )
Value.translated: 开启（使用高质量时会被忽略）

Name.Translated: 环境光遮蔽 - 启用

Description.Original: Enables or disables ambient occlusion usage for the profile.
Description.Translated: 为此配置启用或禁用环境光遮蔽。

Name.Translated: 环境光遮蔽 - 设置

Description.Original: Selects the ambient occlusion quality mode applied when the feature is enabled.
Description.Translated: 选择启用环境光遮蔽时应用的质量模式。

Name.Translated: 最大预渲染帧数

Description.Original: Sets the maximum number of frames the CPU may queue ahead of GPU execution.
Description.Translated: 设置 CPU 在 GPU 执行之前最多可以提前排队的帧数。

Value.translated: 使用 3D 应用程序设置

Name.Translated: 线程优化

Description.Original: Selects whether driver worker-thread optimization is disabled, enabled, or left to the driver default.
Description.Translated: 选择禁用、启用驱动工作线程优化，或使用驱动默认设置。

Name.Translated: 三重缓冲

Description.Original: Enables or disables driver-controlled triple buffering for compatible presentation paths.
Description.Translated: 为兼容的呈现路径启用或禁用由驱动控制的三重缓冲。

Name.Translated: 垂直同步

Description.Original: Selects the vertical synchronization mode applied by the driver.
Description.Translated: 选择驱动应用的垂直同步模式。

Value.translated: 使用 3D 应用程序设置

Name.Translated: 垂直同步 - 撕裂控制

Description.Original: Controls tear handling for the vertical synchronization path.
Description.Translated: 控制垂直同步路径对画面撕裂的处理方式。

Name.Translated: PhysX - 指示浮层

Description.Original: Controls the on-screen overlay that indicates active PhysX acceleration.
Description.Translated: 控制用于指示 PhysX 加速正在运行的屏幕浮层。

Name.Translated: PhysX - 启用 32 位 GPU 加速 (RTX 50)

Description.Original: Controls whether 32-bit PhysX GPU acceleration emulation is enabled for supported RTX 50-series hardware.
Description.Translated: 控制是否为受支持的 RTX 50 系列硬件启用 32 位 PhysX GPU 加速模拟。

Name.Translated: 电源管理 - 模式

Description.Original: Selects the GPU power-management policy used while this profile is active.
Description.Translated: 选择此配置生效时使用的 GPU 电源管理策略。

Name.Translated: CUDA - 强制 P2 状态

Description.Original: Controls whether CUDA workloads are forced into the P2 performance state.
Description.Translated: 控制是否强制 CUDA 工作负载使用 P2 性能状态。

Name.Translated: CUDA - 系统内存回退策略

Description.Original: Selects how CUDA handles fallback to system memory when local video memory is insufficient.
Description.Translated: 选择 CUDA 在本地显存不足时如何回退到系统内存。

Value.translated: 优先不回退到系统内存

Name.Translated: 扩展限制 (OGL)

Description.Original: Controls whether the OpenGL extension exposure limit is enforced for this profile.
Description.Translated: 控制是否为此配置强制执行 OpenGL 扩展公开数量限制。

Name.Translated: 多显示器 / 混合 GPU 加速

Description.Original: Selects the driver acceleration policy used for multi-display and mixed-GPU environments.
Description.Translated: 选择多显示器和混合 GPU 环境使用的驱动加速策略。

Name.Translated: 版本覆盖 (OGL)

Description.Original: Overrides the OpenGL version reported to the application.
Description.Translated: 覆盖向应用程序报告的 OpenGL 版本。

Name.Translated: 多平面叠加 (MPO) 指示器

Description.Original: Controls the debug indicator for multiplane overlay usage.
Description.Translated: 控制用于显示多平面叠加使用状态的调试指示器。

Name.Translated: Vulkan/OpenGL 呈现方式

Description.Original: Selects the presentation method used for Vulkan and OpenGL swap operations.
Description.Translated: 选择 Vulkan 和 OpenGL 交换操作使用的呈现方式。

Value.translated: 优先通过 DXGI 交换链分层呈现

Name.Translated: Vulkan/OpenGL 呈现方式 - 标志

Description.Original: Controls auxiliary flags for the Vulkan and OpenGL presentation method.
Description.Translated: 控制 Vulkan 和 OpenGL 呈现方式的辅助标志。

Value.translated: 0x00080004 - 允许将 DXVK 提升为 DXGI/DirectFlip
0x000802A5 - 将 DXVK 视为原生方式
禁用 - 清除所有调试位

Value.original: ENABLE_DFLIP_ALWAYS - Enable use of direct flip API parameters
Value.translated: ENABLE_DFLIP_ALWAYS - 允许使用直接翻转 API 参数

Value.original: ENABLE_NON_STEREO - Enable DX present on non-stereo windows
Value.translated: ENABLE_NON_STEREO - 允许在非立体窗口上使用 DX 呈现

Value.original: ENABLE_FULLSCREEN_WIN7_STEREO - Enable Win7 fullscreen stereo mechanism
Value.translated: ENABLE_FULLSCREEN_WIN7_STEREO - 启用 Win7 全屏立体显示机制

Name.Translated: DLSS 帧生成 - 强制预设字母

Description.Original: NOTE: "DLSS - Forced Model Preset Profile" setting may need to be changed for this to apply on certain games.\r\nIf set, overrides the DLSS preset/model used across all quality levels (may not be desirable on some levels).
Description.Translated: 注意：在某些游戏中，可能需要更改“DLSS 超分辨率 - 强制模型预设配置”才能使此设置生效。\r\n设置后，将覆盖所有画质级别使用的 DLSS 预设/模型（某些级别可能不适合这样设置）。

Name.Translated: DLSS 帧生成 - 强制模式

Description.Original: This sets up the mode for Frame Generation. Dynamic mode requires driver 595.97 or newer for all features.
Description.Translated: 设置帧生成的运行模式。动态模式的完整功能需要 595.97 或更新版本的驱动。

Name.Translated: DLSS 多帧生成 - 动态目标帧率
DLSS 多帧生成 - 动态帧生成数量
着色器缓存 - 预编译选项

Description.Original: This setting is NVIDIA Auto Shader Compilation, toggle it on to make CPU compile shaders while system is in idle, the settings controls how much system utilization this can take, from low to high.
Description.Translated: 此设置对应 NVIDIA 自动着色器编译功能。启用后，CPU 会在系统空闲时编译着色器；此设置控制允许使用的系统资源级别，从低到高。

Name.Original: Background Application Max Frame Rate For Nvcpl
Name.Translated: 后台应用程序最大帧率 (NVCPL)

Description.Original: Background Application Max Frame Rate for NVCPL
Description.Translated: NVIDIA 控制面板 (NVCPL) 中的后台应用程序最大帧率。

Name.Translated: 控制面板帧率限制器 (NVCPL)

Description.Original: Framerate Limiter FPS only for NVCPL to maintain the previous slider value when the FRL_FPS is set to Disabled.
Description.Translated: 仅供 NVIDIA 控制面板 (NVCPL) 使用的 FPS 帧率限制值，用于在 FRL_FPS 设为 Disabled 时保留先前的滑块值。
